title: Idly sitting on your hands

nodes.speaker: Idlehands
nodes.text: Um, hey, are you... can I help you with something or are you just, like, you know, wandering 'round here looking weird and shit?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Um, hey, are you... can I help you with something or are you just, like, you know, wandering 'round here looking weird and shit?

nodes.text: Hahaha, whooooo! We got a live one here! Everyone come running round and see the--I'm just fucking with you now shut your mouth, k?

nodes.text: What exactly do you expect me to say? You're blabbing around while Sec's got eyes and ears in every light post and data jack!

nodes.speaker: Idlehands
nodes.text: Infuriating. That's what you are. In-fure-re-ate-ing. What are you exactly looking for? And make it quick, yeah? Like, get it onnnnnn.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Infuriating. That's what you are. In-fure-re-ate-ing. What are you exactly looking for? And make it quick, yeah? Like, get it onnnnnn.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, I get it. Need Momma M or Sister S to dance with? Some of those clubs can be extra preeetttyyy with a new set of eyes.
